minutes.headline: Sewer Commission held the business manager hire for references and voted to move permit renewals six months.
minutes.summary: The commission discussed its one interviewed candidate for sewer business manager and agreed to wait on ratifying until references are checked. It voted to extend oil-water separator permit expirations to realign with the April 1 regulation date, and voted to hold the first meeting of each month in person/hybrid at 7 pm. Updates covered the assistant business manager search, special town meeting articles, Mass Ave line repairs and the manhole repair bid.

The commission held ratification of the sewer business manager appointment until its next meeting, after references are checked.
It voted 4-0 to hold the first meeting of each month in person or hybrid at 7 pm at the DPW, with the second meeting on Zoom at 6 pm.
The assistant business manager position will stay unfilled until a business manager is in place.

why_it_matters: The sewer business manager post is still unfilled, so who manages the sewer enterprise fund's billing and finances is not settled until references are checked and the appointment is ratified.
The permit extension moves a small amount of fee revenue to the sewer enterprise fund by six months within the same fiscal year, and businesses holding these permits get a later renewal date.
The in-person first meeting of each month at 7 pm at the DPW sets where residents can attend and speak.
